# Termux-Diffusion Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Non-Root On-Device Stable Diffusion Image Generation Framework for Android Termux
Compiles C++ NEON kernels directly to Android Bionic libc, running Stable Diffusion v1.5 entirely locally within 4GB RAM.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-diffusion
- Command: pip install termux-diffusion
# or:
npm install termux-diffusion
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-diffusion
